**Finding submitted: MISSING (medium severity)**

**What I found:** The agreement has no exit/wind-down provision at all.
- **Section 6 (Termination)** covers only notice periods, payment of final fees, and assignment of Works in progress — nothing on transition help, data return, or deletion.
- **Section 4 (Ownership)** vests title to the Works in Clear Capital but imposes no obligation to actually deliver them back.
- **Section 8 (Confidential Information)** restricts use and disclosure but has no return-or-destroy mechanic.
- Text searches for return/data/confidential surfaced no other candidate language.

Because nothing in the document reaches even the fallback (90 days' assistance + 30-day export), this fails the rule outright.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** New Section 6(d) inserted after p0033 requiring RadialSpark, on any expiry or termination, to (i) provide up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates on request, (ii) return all Works, Confidential Information and Company data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and (iii) delete and certify deletion thereafter. Numbered (d) to avoid colliding with the stray "(c)" paragraph at p0044.

**Negotiation note:** The comment offers the fallback of 90 days' assistance with the same 30-day return timeline if six months is resisted.
